description: This file defines classes for managing firewall configuration commands within a kickstart or system setup context, including multiple versions with different options and features.

classes.name: FC3_Firewall
classes.description: Firewall command class for Fedora Core 3, supporting enabling/disabling and port/trust configuration.

classes.name: F9_Firewall
classes.description: Version-specific subclass for Fedora 9, removing certain options.

classes.name: F10_Firewall
classes.description: Version-specific subclass for Fedora 10, adding service management.

classes.name: F14_Firewall
classes.description: Version-specific subclass for Fedora 14, removing telnet option.

classes.name: F20_Firewall
classes.description: Version-specific subclass for Fedora 20, supporting removal of services.

classes.name: F28_Firewall
classes.description: Version-specific subclass for Fedora 28, adding system defaults option.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing firewall command with optional parameters.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Generates the command string for firewall configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and configures the command-line argument parser for the firewall command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and updates object state accordingly.
